name: No_8
short_caption: The robot performs a quick and subtle double-negative shake of its forearms and hands, indicating disagreement or refusal.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral rest pose, the robot slightly draws both elbows back and brings its forearms inward toward the center, turning its palms somewhat downward with fingers loosely spread. It then executes a rapid, subtle side-to-side shaking motion of both hands and forearms, accompanied by a tiny, almost imperceptible head tilt. After this quick negation gesture, the arms and hands smoothly return to the relaxed neutral hanging posture.
safety_notes: The robot's arm movement is very compact and remains close to its torso, making it exceptionally safe for tight reception desk spaces.
